description: Attribute agent usage cost across chosen dimensions and rank the groups. When a usage log needs cost attributed to owners or components. Do not choose this when you need live billing data from a provider. Example requests: Attribute this agent cost across agents and models. | Which agent is spending the most? | Break down this usage log by dimension.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

dimensions.description: The customer's dimensions.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Comma-separated grouping columns. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

usage_log.description: The customer's usage.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. Usage rows with a cost column. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_agent_cost_attribution
title: Agent cost attribution
